name: Smart Shooter Ltd.
summary: Smart Shooter Ltd. designs, develops, produces, markets, and sells fire control systems in Israel, North America, Europe, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. Its products include SMASH 2000L (3000), SMASH X4, and SMASH Hopper 5000. The company offers solutions for military, special forces, HLS and law enforcement, and counter drones. Smart Shooter Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Yagur, Israel.
